scope: Route 1 native fog dispatch and decoded fog program family

shared_behavior: Discard fragments outside the configured fog interval.
Output fog RGB from cbuf_3[0].xyz and computed fog weight in alpha.

fragment_modes.weight: sample a second 2D fog lookup at normalized range depth, then multiply by cbuf_3[0].w

capture.fog_signature: Every decoded fog fragment variant reads FragCoord and contains an out-of-range discard. Exhaustive inspection of all 36 captured pixel shaders that read FragCoord found no discard, so none can be one of the four fog variants.
capture.conclusion: The captured Route 1 gameplay frame dispatches the native gamma transfer but does not dispatch fog.

implementation.route1: Fog remains disabled. Adding a generic distance fog or guessing constants would contradict the captured frame.
implementation.future_maps: The decoded variants define the implementation family, but a capture that actually dispatches fog is required to select a mode and recover its runtime constants.
